metadata.notes: Selected political routes across 23 starting countries; not exhaustive. Ideology describes the featured phase. Objectives paraphrase pinned official game rules; optional challenges are authored suggestions, not game achievements.

paths.name: Manuel Carlés / Liga Patriótica
paths.notes: Carlés retains power and leads the Patriotic League.
objectives: Carlés retains power and leads the Patriotic League.

paths.name: Ramírez / Grupo de Oficiales Unidos
paths.notes: Ramírez establishes the GOU military junta. Foreign-policy variants are grouped into this political path.
objectives: Ramírez establishes the GOU military junta. Foreign-policy variants are grouped into this political path.

countries.challenge: Build an army equipped entirely by domestic factories.

paths.name: Federalists / Zhang Junmai
paths.notes: Unify China as independent Federalist Liangguang, then pursue Zhang Junmai's Democratic Socialist electoral route. This is a post-unification path, not the starting government.
objectives: Unify China as independent Federalist Liangguang, then pursue Zhang Junmai's Democratic Socialist electoral route. This is a post-unification path, not the starting government.

objectives: The moderate Conservatives win the 1936 election.
